label: The z-score of a period
subgoals: Subtract the mean delay from the period
Divide by the sigma of the delay
Read the result as the number of sigma of margin

label: Yield at a given period
subgoals: Compute the z-score of the period
Look up the standard normal distribution at z
Express the result as a percentage of dies

label: The period for a target yield
section: The period for a target yield
subgoals: Look up the standard normal quantile for the target yield
Multiply it by the delay sigma
Add the mean to get the required period
